{{Top|leg}}
The '''Buntra tree''' was a colossal variety of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that was found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orellon II]]. The native [[Kentra]] lived in villages that consisted of wooden houses in the trees.<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|2|The Prophecy}}</ref>
